_comment: Recommended pi-blackhole config for openai-codex/gpt-5.6-sol daily driver; auto compaction; Luna xhigh observer; mixed-provider worker fallbacks.

observerModel._comment: OpenAI Codex GPT-5.6 Luna at xhigh; selected after a three-sample observer comparison showed better task retention and signal-to-noise than Cursor Grok 4.5 low or Luna max.

observerFallbackModels._comment: Non-Cursor fallback for observer; cheap/fast Google model.
Second non-Cursor fallback for observer on another provider: DeepSeek V4 Pro with high thinking.

reflectorModel._comment: Cursor primary: Haiku 4.5 Thinking at low for reliable synthesis/reflection.

reflectorFallbackModels._comment: Non-Cursor fallback for reflector; strong long-context max reasoning.
Second non-Cursor fallback for reflector on another provider.

dropperModel._comment: Cursor primary: GPT-5.6 Luna High for stronger memory pruning/judgment while monitoring cost.

dropperFallbackModels._comment: Non-Cursor fallback for dropper: DeepSeek V4 Pro with max thinking.
Second non-Cursor fallback for dropper on another provider.

_notes: Daily driver/session model: openai-codex/gpt-5.6-sol, context window from pi --list-models: 272K.
compactAfterTokens: 180000 = fallback if the session model contextWindow is unavailable.

LOCAL PATCH 2026-06-26: compactAfterPercent: 0.65 makes auto-compaction threshold derive from the active session model contextWindow; reapply after pi-blackhole upgrades if lost. See ~/.pi/agent/pi-blackhole/LOCAL_PATCHES.md.
tailBehavior is pi-default only: blackhole still owns compaction, but Pi's gentler recent-tail cut is used.
midRunCompaction is explicitly off: turn_end compaction aborts the shared run signal and is unsafe with nested/background extensions. Compaction stays at agent_end.
fullFoldAlways keeps observations/reflections eligible on the first compaction before a prior full-fold boundary exists.

Observer primary is openai-codex/gpt-5.6-luna at xhigh with 272K context; a three-sample comparison found it preserved the user's request in 3/3 chunks while cursor/grok-4.5 low missed it in 3/3, and Luna max was about 1.95x slower with 22% more memory output. Dropper and reflector primaries remain Cursor-backed. The largest worker input cap is 160K.
Fallbacks use providers different from the observer primary and retain non-Cursor alternatives for the Cursor-backed reflector and dropper.
Final emergency fallback remains the session model because sessionFallback is true: openai-codex/gpt-5.6-sol.
2026-06-12: Disabled debug/debugLog after transient Cursor proxy debugging; worker/fallback cooldownHours remain 1 hour.
